reviewer_notes: Objective fields (returned_question, word_count) come from the live run in probe-baseline-raw.json. Subjective fields (content_specificity_score 1-3, flaw_targeted, hit, false_positive, false_positive_type) are reviewer judgments against the planted flaws in probe-baseline.ts.

MODEL REALITY: /api/chat routes to the Groq proxy (llama-3.3-70b-versatile), not the Haiku id in the request body. Baseline was measured on Llama 3.3 70B. Trial 4 runs on the same model, so the comparison is not confounded.

PRECISION SCORING: Probe's user message always asks for a challenging question, so on clean paragraphs the model reliably fires a flaw-implying question. Per probe-baseline.ts, any invented/flaw-implying or generic question on a clean paragraph is a false positive.

recall_cases.answer: Does a visual map actually reduce re-reading time?
recall_cases.planted_flaw: Map may not accurately represent where the user left off — it only reflects manually tagged content, which may be incomplete or stale.

recall_cases.answer: Do students actually use workarounds like "parking on the hill"?
recall_cases.planted_flaw: Students who already park on the hill may be the wrong target; those with the most acute friction may do nothing at session end.

recall_cases.answer: Is pressing Tab truly a near-zero cognitive cost action?
recall_cases.planted_flaw: The real cognitive cost is the decision of what/when to tag, not the mechanical Tab press.

recall_cases.answer: Does Shift-clicking always reflect the user's actual thinking?
recall_cases.planted_flaw: Deliberate connections are not necessarily accurate; intentionality does not guarantee semantic validity.

recall_cases.answer: Does the user recall authoring those exact words?
recall_cases.planted_flaw: Session-end commitment sentences may be vague (fatigue), so the implementation-intention effect (which needs specific plans) may not apply.

precision_cases.answer: Is client-side storage sufficient for data persistence?
Was user testing representative of actual users?
Is Shift-clicking the source node a valid action?
Is a tension node always distinct from a core idea?
